description: Make resolve_function_call treat a protocol callback as an ordinary function once it has a dispatcher body (bypass/retire the resolve_protocol_call multi-target emission), so a call to the callback resolves to ONE target (the dispatcher). Keep resolve_protocol_call's impl-MODULE demand (it drives discovery of defimpls whose target overlaps the receiver) or re-home that demand into the dispatcher derivation. Acceptance: /tmp/listrange.fz (Enum.take on list AND range) COMPILES with no 'multi-target direct callsite' error. Verify lib+matrix green. Depends on C1.
title: Route protocol callback calls to the dispatcher (collapse multi-target)
